summary: Electrovaya Inc., a lithium-ion battery company, filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the date for its Q3 2026 financial results conference call. The results will be released after market close on August 10, 2026, followed by a call on August 11, 2026, hosted by the CEO and CFO. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review. It is a routine earnings announcement notice, which does not qualify as a special situation. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or advisors mentioned; nothing to watch beyond the earnings release itself.
